rule: The Notion HACP rows are the source of truth for human review and communication (principal, 2026-10-03). Each floor page below mirrors its row; a page edited after its `synced` date fails scripts/hacp_sync_check.py until it is re-mirrored and `synced` is bumped. The index row is NAVIGATION ONLY, carrying the inline membership database and NO hand-maintained entry table (principal, 2026-10-26, superseding the 2026-10-14 wording which mandated the table and forbade it in the same sentence): measured state, the timeline and the decision history live on status-and-history.md. Before any HACP write, read the governance contract at https://app.notion.com/p/313fda9448094029904f344523d5bd01 and CLAUDE.md §HACP.

notes.sync_check_defect: scripts/hacp_sync_check.py infers 'edited' from the file's last commit date on the CURRENT branch (git log -1 --format=%aI). That is a correct reading of the commit date attributed to the wrong subject: content freshness. A page landed on main BY CONTENT from another branch is reported as drifted although its bytes are exactly what was mirrored, and it stays reported until someone bumps a date the content does not justify - which invites falsifying a sync record to silence a check. Measured 2026-10-23: 13 of 13 'drifted' ChipSim pages were byte-identical to their pre-sync blobs, so the report was 13 false positives and 0 real drift. PROPER FIX, not applied in the same commit that relies on this checker to declare the floor green: record a content hash per page here and compare hashes instead of dates. Deliberately left as a recorded defect rather than silenced.
